name: My Zypp Stikks 1g Infused Preroll - Velvet Gelato
description:
Infused and ready to spark. The My Zypp Stikks Velvet Gelato is a 1-gram infused pre-roll packed with quality flower for a bolder, more potent smoke. No grinding, no rolling, just light it and go.

Velvet Gelato brings a rich, dessert-forward profile: creamy gelato sweetness up front with soft berry notes and a smooth, velvety finish.

1G infused pre-roll — quality flower infused for extra potency
Signature Velvet Gelato flavor — creamy gelato sweetness with soft berry notes
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

My Zypp Stikks Velvet Gelato is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
